native_runtime.filesystem_policy: Actual volume results only; filesystem type NOT_COLLECTED unless independently measured. No APFS-only claim from runner label. statvfs fields recorded; required rename operations themselves must execute with exact results. All seven remain NOT_RUN until actual Darwin invocation.

common.storage: Fresh own mkdtemp child under actual TEMP; per-case own subdirectory, single directory FD, fixed leaf names; retain artifacts, no recursive cleanup.
common.facts_required: Raw operation sequence with integer return/errno, exact intent/leaf/fd role, phase, synthetic read hex+sha256+size and fstat/lstat device/inode/link/size. Summary assertions require raw support. All own handles closed once. Failure/partial/unavailable is not a prevention PASS.
limitations: No mandatory content freeze from held descriptor

cases.name: ordinary_create_write_fsync_pread
steps: create stage.bin O_RDWR|O_CREAT|O_EXCL|O_NOFOLLOW mode0600
write exact A, fsync
pread exact4096 from offset0; fstat
close each own FD once
reopen same own stage.bin readonly nofollow, read A, close
cases.limit: fsync success is not byte immutability or powerloss proof

cases.name: rename_excl_fresh_destination
steps: create stage.bin writeA/fsync, hold own FD
renameatx_np(case_dirfd,stage.bin,case_dirfd,published.bin,RENAME_EXCL4)
check stage absent, publishedA, identityheld==published; preadheldA
close own descriptors once
cases.limit: source selected by a leaf name relative to held directory, not rename-by-source-FD

cases.name: rename_excl_existing_destination_preserved
steps: create distinct stageA and existing publishedC, write/fsync, hold source FD
renameatx_np(case_dirfd,stage.bin,case_dirfd,published.bin,RENAME_EXCL4)
record -1/EEXIST17 and reread stageA/publishedC/heldA
check distinct identities preserved; close
cases.limit: Required paired M02 successful rename; ENOENT/EACCES/ENOTSUP are not no-clobber credit

cases.name: unicode_exclusive_rename
steps: create stage.bin withA/fsync, hold FD
renameatx_np with target published-Δ-Ж.bin UTF8 leaf under same held directory
check source absent exact target name lookup A and same identity; readheldA, close
cases.limit: Finite exact Unicode path example, not normalization/casefold/full locale support

cases.name: held_object_survives_pathname_replacement
steps: create stageA/fsync and hold readonly FD
rename own stage.bin to original.bin
create a different own fileB at stage.bin/fsync
read heldFD A; read stage pathnameB; read original.binA
check held identity==original, heldidentity!=newstage; close
cases.limit: Own deterministic sequence, no foreign-process attacker or original app defect newly executed

cases.name: held_descriptor_does_not_freeze_same_inode_bytes
steps: create stageA/fsync, hold own readonly FD; readA and fstat
open same stage via second own O_WRONLY|O_NOFOLLOW FD; pwrite exact B at0; fsync; close writer
read heldFD B and fstat same device/inode before-after; read pathB
close remaining own descriptors once
cases.limit: Ownership of a descriptor proves selected object, not immutable contents; no advisory lock/native process experiment

cases.name: own_unlink_retains_open_object
steps: create stageA and controlC/fsync; hold readonly source FD
unlink own stage.bin relative case directory FD
check stage ENOENT2; heldFD stillA and identityunchanged; controlC preserved
close heldFD once; close directoryFD once; retain control and evidence
cases.limit: No concurrent substitution between checks/unlink; not an expected-inode conditional-delete API or FS15 cleanup repair

acceptance.unsupported: NOT_EXERCISED_UNSUPPORTED, incomplete/native acceptance false; preserve raw errno; no fallback
acceptance.partial_or_unexpected: INCOMPLETE_OR_UNEXPECTED, nonzero collector exit, raw retained; not app or platform approval

optional_not_in_first_pilot.F_FULLFSYNC: Apple recommends for tighter storage ordering; not executed in7casepilot, not silently credited by fsync
optional_not_in_first_pilot.advisory_flock: Documented cooperative/advisory, not executed in first ownfilepilot or treated as mandatory protection

primary_sources.claim: RENAME_EXCL4 and renameatx_np exact signature; macOS10.12 API availability
Directory-FD relative selection, supported-filesystem RENAME_EXCL EEXIST; unsupported ENOTSUP; ordinary rename replacement not permitted fallback
unlink removes name; last open ref retains object; no expected-inode argument
flock advisory/cooperative, not noncooperating-byte freeze; no flock execution planned
fsync host-to-drive, hardware caching/order limitations; F_FULLFSYNC tighter request not global proof
Native volume support for RENAME_EXCL must not be assumed for all filesystems

envelope.runtime: actual system/platform/Python/architecture/isolation/uid/euid plus volume_metadata with filesystem_type NOT_COLLECTED unless measured

case_record.snapshots: named stat snapshots for raw identity/bytes facts
case_record.facts: named summary results, independently crossvalidated against events/reads/snapshots
case_record.complete: exactbool true only after all plannedrequiredoperations including finalclose

event.role: logical own FD role or relative leaf role
event.return: exact integer native/normalizedPython return, bool excluded
event.errno: exact integer0 on success; actualpositive errno on exception/native-1; bool excluded

snapshot.errno: 0 if exists else exact2 for absent expectedpath

record_schema_proposal.strictness: Missing/duplicate/extra/reordered cases, boolean integers, unsupportedrawsummary, missing attempted operation, false completion, closefailure, nonzero unexpectederrno reject. Schema may be refined by root BEFORE first execution; no postoutcome weakening. Concrete RECORD_CONTRACT is a separate prerequired schema freeze; it cannot change these semantic outcomes.
record_schema_proposal.native_origin_rule: Nativeorigin requires actualDarwinruntime; syntheticfixture cannot be relabelednative, and aLinux wronghost refusal cannot count7 nativecases.
